## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and what changes for the operator.

## Scope and design

Link the issue/approved plan. Explain decisions, compatibility, and authority changes.

## Evidence

Record the exact snapshot, commands, environment, and outcomes. Separate executed evidence from reviewed reports.

| Check | Command / evidence | Outcome |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Relevant checks | | passed / failed / skipped / blocked / inconclusive |

## Gaps and operational impact

State what was not checked, risks, migrations, recovery, and added resource or permission needs.

## Review

- [ ] The diff is scoped and contains no credentials, private artifacts, or unrelated changes.
- [ ] Required behavior has meaningful evidence; missing/skipped checks are explained.
- [ ] Instructions, docs, contracts, and third-party notices are updated where relevant.
- [ ] Security-sensitive workflow, dependency, policy, and execution changes are called out.
- [ ] The title follows Conventional Commits; breaking changes are identified.

A checklist does not replace executed results or authorize publication/deployment.
